journal_lines: Marks cut into the stone face. §oDeep cuts, worn smooth at the edges. Sat with it. Left rested.
Found an inscription half-swallowed by lichen. §oThe stone smelled different where the marks were. Stayed longer than planned.
Old carving in a sheltered wall. Did not understand it. Sat in front of it until the sun moved. Felt calmer after.
The marks were deliberate and very old. §oSmelled of nothing alive. Rested here anyway. Slept well.
Stopped at a carved stone in the middle of nowhere. Nowhere was quiet. The stone made it quieter.
Letters cut by hands I could not picture. Sat with my back to the stone. §oFelt like the right place to stop.
Lichen had grown around the inscription without covering it. §oAs if something had been tended. Rested in the shade of it.
Could not say what the carving meant. Could say that sitting near it was easy. Left when I felt ready.
